title: pwe-inc-heavyweight
label: Nicholas Pryde

won.source: The fed's own front-page news of 5 December 2005: "PWE HEAVYWEIGHT CHAMPIONSHIP: Ryan Styles (c) v. Nicholas Pryde... it was The Professor who came out on top", and its own results line, "Main Event: PWE Heavyweight Championship: Nicholas Pryde d. Ryan Styles © via submission" (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/front-page-news-2005-12-05.html).

how: Beat Ryan Styles by submission in the main event of Deadly Game.
note: Still champion at the fed's own last word.

title: pwe-inc-heavyweight
label: Ryan Styles

won.source: Nothing held records when or how he won it. The fed's own roster records name his biggest match as a Heavyweight Title match against Wildfool at Saga III on 22 May 2005 and call him a former champion (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/the-new-revenge-roster-records-2005-05-31.html).

how: Lost to Nicholas Pryde by submission in the main event of Deadly Game at Madison Square Garden.

title: pwe-inc-television
label: The Regulator

won.source: Nothing held records when he won it. The fed's own roster records call him the longest-reigning Television Champion in PWE history at 308 days, and the holder of the longest championship reign of any kind in its history (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/the-new-revenge-roster-records-2005-05-31.html).

how: The fed's own record does not say how it ended.
note: For part of 2005 the belt had two holders at once: Revenge's own authority figure named The Regulator and Alex Hoffman co-champions after both made Tatewaki Kuno submit in the same match (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/front-page-news-2005-05-01.html).

title: pwe-inc-television
label: Homicide

won.source: Nothing held records when he won it; the fed's own roster records of 7 November 2005 call him the current Television Champion (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/the-new-revenge-roster-records-2005-05-31.html).

how: Kept it against The Amityville Horror by pinfall at Deadly Game on 27 November 2005.
note: Still champion at the fed's own last word.

title: pwe-inc-iron-man
label: Clarke "The X" Andrews

won.source: The fed's own roster records name his biggest match "PWE Iron Man Championship: Clarke Andrews v. The Elite (The Reckoning - July 2nd, 2005)" and call him a former champion (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/the-new-revenge-roster-records-2005-05-31.html).

how: The fed's own record does not say how it ended; The Prototype held the belt by November.
note: The fed's own record does not say when he lost it to Prototype; only that Prototype held it into Deadly Game 2005.

title: pwe-inc-iron-man
label: Lee Nolan

won.source: The fed's own Deadly Game results: "PWE Iron Man Championship: 30-minute Iron Man Match: Lee Nolan d. The Prototype © via three falls to zero" (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/front-page-news-2005-12-05.html).

how: Beat champion Prototype three falls to zero in a 30-minute Iron Man Match.
note: Still champion at the fed's own last word. The Prototype's own reign between Clarke Andrews and this one is named by the result and never dated.

title: pwe-inc-iron-man
label: The Elite

won.source: Nothing held records when he won it. The fed's own roster records name his biggest match as an Iron Man Title defence in an Ultimate X match at Saga III on 22 May 2005 and call him a former champion (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/the-new-revenge-roster-records-2005-05-31.html).

how: Lost it to Clarke "The X" Andrews at The Reckoning.

title: pwe-inc-undisputed-tag-team
label: The Prodigal Sons

won.source: PWE's own Last Man Standing 2005, where The Prodigal Sons beat The Patriots (Daniel Justice & Joey Legend) for the title, Robbie Crockett pinning Justice with a cradle (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/pwe-last-man-standing-2005-2005-08-30.html).

how: Beat The Patriots (Daniel Justice & Joey Legend) for the vacant/prior title, Robbie Crockett pinning Justice with a cradle.
note: Still champions at the fed's own last word.

title: pwe-inc-intercontinental
label: Christian

won.source: Nothing held records when or how he won it — he is billed a co-champion (“©”) entering the Deadly Game unification match (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/front-page-news-2005-12-05.html).

how: Lost a Three Way Asylum Match to Postal Maniac, also involving DisasterPiece, who grabbed both this belt and the PWE Silver Crown to unify them.
note: The fed's own record does not say whether DisasterPiece also held this title as a co-champion or only challenged for it; the front page bills only Christian with the © mark.

title: pwe-inc-silver-crown
label: Postal Maniac

won.source: PWE's own Deadly Game results, unifying the Silver Crown and Intercontinental Championships in a Three Way Asylum Match over Christian and DisasterPiece (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/front-page-news-2005-12-05.html).

how: Won a Three Way Asylum Match by grabbing both the Silver Crown and Intercontinental belts to unify them.
note: Nothing held records who held the Silver Crown before this unification.

title: pwe-inc-iron-man
label: Prototype

won.source: Nothing held records when or how he won it from Clarke Andrews — he is shown defending it in a promo on Revenge from Pontiac, Michigan, 10 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/pwe-revenge-from-pontiac-michigan-2005-10-10.html).

how: Lost a 30-minute Iron Man Match to Lee Nolan, three falls to zero, at Deadly Game 2005.

title: pwe-inc-pure
label: Jeff Jarrett

won.source: PWE's own front-page news of 1 May 2005, which carries “PWE Pure Championship: Jeff Jarrett d. Crunch (c) via pinfall” at Annihilation — the show itself is not among the held record's documents (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/front-page-news-2005-05-01.html).

how: Beat champion Crunch by pinfall at Annihilation.
note: Annihilation itself is not among the held record's documents; no event link is possible.

title: pwe-inc-world-heavyweight-underground
label: Chaos

won.source: Nothing held records when or how he won it. Tex Graham's own promo names Kurt Angle, ZerO, himself and Deuce Jackson as prior holders before Chaos, spoken evidence only (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/underground-network-oct-10-milw-wi-2005-10-09.html).

how: Lost to Bulldozer by pinfall, with a sledgehammer shot once the referee was knocked cold.
note: A community wrap-up column corroborates the same result the next day while airing a dispute over the two writers' own RP agreement (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/to-be-a-champion-2005-10-11.html).
